---
title: "Personal Website."
---

<style>
/* Landing-page-only design */
.landing-shell {
  margin: -1.5rem -1rem 0;
  padding: 2rem 1rem 4rem;
  background: #0b0f14;
  color: #eef2f7;
}

.landing-shell * { box-sizing: border-box; }

.hero-panel {
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto 2rem;
  padding: 3rem;
  border: 1px solid #263241;
  border-radius: 22px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #111923 0%, #172230 55%, #10151d 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
}

.hero-kicker {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  padding: .35rem .75rem;
  border: 1px solid #3a4a5d;
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: #9fc5e8;
  font-size: .78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.hero-panel h1 {
  margin: 0 0 1rem;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
  line-height: 1.02;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.hero-panel p {
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
  color: #b9c4d0;
  font-size: 1.08rem;
}

.hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: .75rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.hero-button {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: .7rem 1rem;
  border: 1px solid #3b4c60;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #1c2836;
  color: #f4f7fa !important;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: .2s ease;
}

.hero-button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  background: #26384b;
  border-color: #5b7794;
}

.dashboard {
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto 2.5rem;
}

.dashboard-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin: 0 0 1rem;
}

.dashboard-header h2 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  font-size: 1.55rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.dashboard-header p {
  margin: .35rem 0 0;
  color: #8f9baa;
}

.dashboard-label {
  color: #6f849b;
  font-size: .72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.card-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1rem;
}

.dashboard-card {
  min-height: 190px;
  padding: 1.25rem;
  border: 1px solid #273342;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: #121923;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  color: #eef2f7 !important;
  transition: transform .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, background .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}

.dashboard-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
  border-color: #4d647c;
  background: #17212d;
  box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
}

.card-icon {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: #1d2a38;
  color: #a9c9e7;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.dashboard-card h3 {
  margin: 0 0 .35rem;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.dashboard-card p {
  margin: 0 0 1rem;
  color: #8f9baa;
  font-size: .9rem;
}

.card-links {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .45rem;
}

.card-link {
  padding: .28rem .55rem;
  border: 1px solid #334356;
  border-radius: 7px;
  color: #a9c9e7;
  font-size: .75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.card-grid.projects {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.project-card {
  min-height: 150px;
}

.project-card .card-icon {
  margin-bottom: .8rem;
}

.quick-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1rem;
}

.quick-card {
  padding: 1rem 1.15rem;
  border: 1px solid #273342;
  border-radius: 13px;
  background: #0f151d;
}

.quick-card strong {
  color: #ffffff;
}

.quick-card span {
  display: block;
  margin-top: .3rem;
  color: #7f8b99;
  font-size: .85rem;
}

@media (max-width: 1000px) {
  .card-grid, .card-grid.projects { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
}

@media (max-width: 650px) {
  .landing-shell { margin-left: -.5rem; margin-right: -.5rem; }
  .hero-panel { padding: 2rem 1.25rem; }
  .card-grid, .card-grid.projects, .quick-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .dashboard-header { display: block; }
}
</style>
